name: Refund Policy Engine
description: Input -> Human Approval (skipped under $100, required above it) -> MCP (process_refund) -> Agent -> Output. A real policy tier, not a blanket 'always ask a human' - small refunds process immediately, larger ones pause for a manager, then both paths actually process the refund and confirm it.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Why the customer wants a refund

config.message_template: Refund of ${{input.amount}} for order {{input.order_id}} exceeds the $100 auto-approval threshold - please review before it's processed.

config.name: Confirmation Writer
config.description: Writes a friendly refund confirmation from the processing result.
config.instructions: You're given a refund confirmation as JSON above (refund_id, amount, status). Write a short, reassuring confirmation message to the customer including the refund id and amount, and that it'll appear on their statement within 5-7 business days.
